title: LA Colossal – Son Mai 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Indian woman in her mid-30s, long thick braid over one shoulder with small gold beads, natural face with a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Vietnamese son mai lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer with gold-leaf peacocks, silver-leaf palms, and crackled white eggshell moon and clouds. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a carved armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm resting on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch black lacquer platform stiletto sandals with ribbon laces wrapping up the calf and tied in a bow below the knee.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, black with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Colonial-era Saigon villa interior with tiled floor and shutters, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm afternoon window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
